name: CSN 3235 完全准备 强风切变

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is China Southern 235, a flight from Beijing to Shanghai Hongqiao, you are parking at 217, you have got information Golf, contact Beijing Delivery and request ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 China Southern 235，从北京飞往上海虹桥，停在 217，已收到通播 Golf，联系北京放行并请求 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Delivery, CSN3235, gate 217, information G, request ATC clearance to Shanghai Hongqiao.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京放行，CSN3235，217 号登机口，通播 G，请求飞往上海虹桥的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 235, Beijing Delivery, cleared to Shanghai Hongqiao via flight planned route, departure runway 08L, Lima Mike November 41 departure, initial climb 1500 meters, cruising level 9200 meters, after departure, contact 119.8, squawk 3223.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 235，北京放行，许可飞往上海虹桥，按飞行计划航路，离场跑道 08L，Lima Mike November 41 离场，起始爬升 1500 米，巡航高度 9200 米，离场后联系 119.8，应答机 3223。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Shanghai Hongqiao via flight planned route, departure runway 08L, LMN 41 departure, initial climb 1500 meters, cruising level 9200 meters, after departure, contact 119.8, squawk 3223, CSN3235.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可飞往上海虹桥，按飞行计划航路，离场跑道 08L，LMN 41 离场，起始爬升 1500 米，巡航高度 9200 米，离场后联系 119.8，应答机 3223，CSN3235。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 235, your slot time is 0800, expect 15 minutes delay due temporary airway restriction.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 235，你的时隙是 0800，因临时航路限制预计延误 15 分钟。
cards.referenceText: Roger, slot time 0800, expect 15 minutes delay, CSN3235.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，时隙 0800，预计延误 15 分钟，CSN3235。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 235, the airway restriction has been cancelled, report ready for start up.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 235，航路限制已取消，报告准备好开车。
cards.referenceText: Roger, report ready for start up, CSN3235.

cards.audioText: B: All the passengers have boarded the aircraft, all cabin doors have been closed, you are fully ready.
cards.audioTextZh: B：所有旅客已登机，所有客舱门已关闭，你完全准备好。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CSN3235, all passengers have boarded the aircraft, all cabin doors have been closed, fully ready.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CSN3235，所有旅客已登机，所有客舱门已关闭，完全准备好。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 235, start up approved.
B: Now you are ready for push back.
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CSN3235, ready for push back.

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 235, push back approved, facing south.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 235，同意推出，机头朝南。
cards.referenceText: Push back approved, facing south, CSN3235.

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed the push back, you are ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已完成推出，准备好滑行。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CSN3235, push back completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CSN3235，推出完成，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 235, taxi via taxiway Tango 4, Delta and Alpha to holding point runway 08L.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 235，经滑行道 Tango 4、Delta 和 Alpha 滑行至跑道 08L 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway T4, D and A to holding point runway 08L, CSN3235.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 T4、D 和 A 滑行至跑道 08L 等待点，CSN3235。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are holding short of runway 08L, you are ready for departure, contact Beijing Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 08L 外等待，准备好离场，联系北京塔台。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CSN3235, holding short of runway 08L, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CSN3235，跑道 08L 外等待，准备好离场。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 235, line up runway 08L and cleared for takeoff, caution strong wind shear at the departure end of the runway.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 235，进入跑道 08L 并可以起飞，注意跑道离场端有强风切变。
cards.referenceText: Line up runway 08L and cleared for takeoff, roger, thanks, CSN3235.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进入跑道 08L 并可以起飞，收到，谢谢，CSN3235。

cards.audioText: B: Just after liftoff, you encountered strong wind shear between the surface and 200 meters, report it to Beijing Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：刚离地后，你在地面至 200 米之间遭遇强风切变，向北京离场报告。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, CSN3235, we encountered strong wind shear between the surface and 200 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，CSN3235，我们在地面至 200 米之间遭遇强风切变。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 235, roger, climb to 4200 meters, resume own navigation to Lima Mike November.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 235，收到，爬升至 4200 米，恢复自主导航至 Lima Mike November。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 4200 meters, resume own navigation to LMN, CSN3235.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至 4200 米，恢复自主导航至 LMN，CSN3235。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 235, continue climb to 5100 meters, contact Beijing Control on 118.9.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 235，继续爬升至 5100 米，联系北京管制118.9。
